headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of May 5, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 13.11% compared to SPY's 6.81%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 6.30%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, OpenAI 10, has achieved a return of 15.43%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, Random A, returned 8.23%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's holdings. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
